synthesis: Provider-facing documentation of every RDN Statistics metric Clarity publishes to the RDN SQS queue. The code is small and unambiguous: App\Enums\RdnMetricType defines exactly 5 hour-grain, org-level metric types, fanned out hourly by DispatchRdnMetricsHourly and sent one-envelope-per-(org,metric,hour) by RdnMetricsPublisher over SQS. The deliverable is a written spec RDN can build against, matching exactly what the publisher emits today — NOT the larger day/month/agent-level surface the epic's child tickets describe (none of which exist in code). All facts below were verified directly against source, not just the prep sub-agent report.

NO code changes — pure documentation.

questions.q: Where should the provider-facing doc live and in what format? Options: (A) okf/concepts/rdn-provider-integration.md — fits the repo's canonical wiki + sits beside the existing engineering-facing okf/concepts/rdn.md; (B) docs/integrations/rdn-metrics-spec.md — new subfolder, no precedent; (C) external Confluence page. Recommendation: A (in-repo, versioned with the code, cross-linkable from rdn.md), which also becomes the single source RDN's shared copy is exported from.
questions.answer: okf/ wiki: new okf/concepts/rdn-provider-integration.md, beside okf/concepts/rdn.md. In-repo markdown, versioned with code; the single source RDN's shared copy is exported from.

questions.q: Should the doc mention the day/month/agent-level Phase-2 metrics at all (e.g. a short 'planned / not yet published' note), or document ONLY the 5 currently-published hour-grain metrics? Recommendation: document only the 5 live metrics, with a one-line note that additional grains/dimensions are planned but not yet emitted — so RDN isn't surprised later but doesn't build against non-existent payloads now.
questions.answer: Document strictly the 5 currently-published hour-grain metrics. No forward-looking / Phase-2 mention.

questions.q: idempotency_key is present on every real message but is absent from the original DEV-1830/DEV-1835 envelope spec RDN saw — document it?
questions.answer: Yes. Code is authoritative for what is actually sent; it belongs in the envelope table with its semantics (SHA1 of rdn_org_identifier|metric_type|metric_range_start|metric_range_end, stable across resends, intended for RDN-side dedup against at-least-once delivery).

No fixed format. orgs.rdn_id is varchar(64), RDN-issued at onboarding, stored verbatim; no regex/format enforced in Clarity code or DB. Document as 'opaque RDN-issued string, <=64 chars'; the AZ-style value is illustrative only.

notes: okf/concepts/rdn.md already documents this integration for an ENGINEERING audience (schedule internals, idempotency rationale, ClickHouse sources). Strong drafting reference, but internal-facing and mixes detail RDN doesn't need — not itself the deliverable.
Grep confirmed 18 of the epic's 21 child tickets show 'Done' despite no matching code (likely bulk-closed/consolidated). Code is ground truth: document only the 5 implemented hour-grain metrics.
All 5 metric types share ONE payload shape: data = [{count: <int>}]. None uses a type-keyed multi-row data array (that only appears in unimplemented Phase-2 tickets).
Hit-type meanings grounded in app/Enums/HitTypeEnum.php + okf/models/hits.md: L=Live, H=Historical, S=Staging Live, Z=Staging Historical (staging = hits against another org's staged hotlist).

Grep backstop (missed-caller sweep) is N/A: no code symbols are being modified (docs-only). Instead the code-truth enumeration was independently verified by the driver reading RdnMetricType, RdnMetricsPublisher, both CH queries, DispatchRdnMetricsHourly, PublishRdnMetric, routes/console.php and config/services.php.

grounding.code_flow: Schedule (hourlyAt 5; prod+platform+queue_url gate) -> DispatchRdnMetricsHourly::handle() computes window [prevHour, thisHour) UTC, resolves eligibleOrgs() [rdn_id non-blank AND meta.platform_repo_pro=true AND meta.platform_repo_pro_rdn_metrics_push=true AND proTier in {PRO_LITE, CLARITY_PRO}] -> per org, one RdnHitHourCountQuery round-trip precomputes all 4 hit counts, then Bus::batch of 5 PublishRdnMetric jobs (1 per RdnMetricType) -> each job -> RdnMetricsPublisher::publish() resolves scan count itself (RdnScanHourCountQuery) if scan, builds envelope, Sqs::sendRdnMetricsMessage(). tries=1 + SDK retries=0 = at-most-once; idempotency_key for RDN-side dedup.

keys.name: metric_range_start
keys.semantics: Inclusive start of the counted window; always the start of a COMPLETED UTC hour (never the in-progress hour).

keys.name: metric_range_end
keys.semantics: EXCLUSIVE end of the window (hit query uses strict '<'). Always exactly 1 hour after start in Phase 1.

keys.name: rdn_org_identifier
keys.semantics: Opaque RDN-issued org identifier; Clarity stores it verbatim as orgs.rdn_id. No format enforced by Clarity. Orgs without a non-blank rdn_id never emit any message.

keys.name: idempotency_key
keys.semantics: SHA1 of rdn_org_identifier|metric_type|metric_range_start|metric_range_end. Stable across resends of the same (org,metric,window). For RDN-side dedup; Clarity delivery is at-most-once and never deliberately resends.

keys.name: data
keys.semantics: Per-metric rows. For all 5 metric types today this is a single object with one integer `count`. Multi-row/type-keyed data is not emitted (Phase 2 only).

delivery_model.cadence: Hourly at minute 5 (hourlyAt(5)), one tick per completed UTC hour. Runs only when env=production AND app.name=platform AND RDN_METRICS_QUEUE_URL is configured.
delivery_model.granularity_of_message: One SQS message per (org, metric_type, hour) => up to 5 messages per eligible org per hour.
delivery_model.eligibility: Org has non-blank rdn_id AND org_meta.platform_repo_pro=true AND org_meta.platform_repo_pro_rdn_metrics_push=true AND proTier in {PRO_LITE, CLARITY_PRO}.
delivery_model.delivery_guarantee: At-most-once (PublishRdnMetric tries=1, AWS SDK retries=0, non-FIFO queue). A whole org's hour is dropped rather than sent partial. idempotency_key lets RDN dedup if they choose.
delivery_model.transport: AWS SQS, region us-east-2 (default), profile insight_sqs_production (default), queue from RDN_METRICS_QUEUE_URL.
